name: The Rock
tagline: Waits for big cards and sees cheap flops, folds the rest and never bluffs; short-stacked, goes all in with any good hand.

table.why: Short-stacked, 25 big blinds or less, and a hand worth playing: all in, before the blinds eat the stack.
Premium cards and nobody has raised: raise.
Premium cards against a raise: call, and let them keep betting into it.
Strong cards and nobody has raised: open with a raise.
Strong or medium cards against one raise: call and see a flop.
Speculative cards and a small raise: call, hoping to flop a set or better.
In the big blind with nothing to call: a free flop.
Medium or speculative cards and two big blinds or less to call: a cheap flop.
Not a hand the Rock plays for this price: wait for a better one.
A premium pair is still a pair the Rock won't let go of: bet it.
A premium pair and no raise possible: call, whatever it costs.
Two pair or better: bet for value.
Two pair or better, no raise possible: call.
A pair with a fair chance: check and keep the pot small.
A pair with a fair chance: call, but don't raise with one pair.
No pair worth paying for, and chips to call: fold.

raise_to.desc: The total bet when raising: three big blinds to open, three times the bet facing a raise, half the pot after the flop
raise_to.expr: if street = "preflop" then (if raises = 0 then 3 * big_blind else 3 * current_bet) else decimal(pot * 0.5, 0)
